# Commands console reliability, Commit UI, task recovery, storage retention, and patch identity

Verify may repair source/tests but must not change Git state. If it leaves edits, Implement prepares/builds, commits or amends, then runs Verify again. Persisted task errors need explicit `POST /api/implement/<id>/retry` with the current interactive token; a verifying phase is not end-to-end success. [Task 8]
